category.why: Primark sells its own label (kind brand), so C is a product type. Its own site is behind a bot check, so the choice rests on Ahrefs top pages for www.primark.com/en-us/ (US, 2026-10-28): after the store locator and department pages (the women's department is the largest), the highest-traffic product-type pages are women's pajama sets (est. 630/month) and women's tops and t-shirts (est. 539/month). The outside lists frame Primark on cheap everyday basics (Primark US's president: 'everyday essentials at affordable prices'), and tops are the like-for-like item every candidate store sells, which pajamas are not. Like-for-like item: women's tops and T-shirts (tees, tanks, camis, blouses, shirts, bodysuits); sweaters, cardigans, hoodies, sweatshirts, jackets and sets excluded. Prices are each store's regular (not marked-down) price as a US shopper is charged.

author: Ash

copy.intro: You want a Primark-style haul of cheap tees and tanks, and then you check the map. Primark has under 50 US stores, so the nearest one can be a long drive. These are the places to go instead, including Target's $8 house labels and a few organic cotton labels that ship from Europe. They're ordered by how often outside lists name them, so the most-recommended come first.

bodies.target:
Target is our first stop for cheap everyday tops, because its own labels start at $8 a tee. Start with A New Day's Women's Short Sleeve Perfect T-Shirt ($8).

Stick to the house labels to keep the bill down. A New Day covers plain tees and tanks, while Wild Fable is the trend line, with pieces like the Long Sleeve Triangle Flyaway Top ($25). Full-price tops here sit between $8 and $28, and you can buy them in a store or online.

It also gives you longer to change your mind. Returns run 90 days on most things and a full year on Target's own labels, if you keep the receipt. That's far longer than the 30 days most picks on this list give you.
bodies.missguided:
Missguided has the lowest full prices on this list, with its own-label tops running from $5.40 to $10.70. The Fitted Crop Top With Text Print Front ($5.40) is the cheapest of them.

Read the label in each product title before you buy. The US store mixes Missguided's own pieces with other sellers' labels, and most listings show a markdown, so the price you see is often not the full one. Shipping costs $4.49 until you pass $67.49, which takes a lot of $10 tops.

You get 30 days to return things but pay the postage yourself, and bodysuits can't go back at all. If you'd rather return things in person, Target is easier.
bodies.forever-21:
Forever 21, the Los Angeles label founded in 1984, is the pick for trend-led tops under $40, now that it sells online only. Full-price tops start at $9.98 for the Seamless Tank Bodysuit, and the Striped Knit Cropped Halter Top ($36.99) is about as high as they go.

Most of its tops carry a markdown, so treat the full price as the ceiling. The core range stops at XXL, plus sizes have their own section, and orders ship free from $50.

Its US shops shut in 2025, so you can't try anything on first, and returns cost $9.99. Clearance and final-sale buys are non-returnable, which makes Old Navy the safer bet if you're unsure of fit.
bodies.old-navy:
Old Navy is the easy one for cheap everyday tops you can buy in person, and it has shops in 49 states. It's Gap Inc.'s value label, open since 1994. The First-Layer Ribbed Scoop-Neck Tank Top ($12.99) is its cheapest full-price top.

Most tops sit between $19.99 and $39.99, a step up from Target's house labels. Many carry an extra 20% off in the app, so open that before you pay. Free shipping starts at $50 for rewards members, and joining costs nothing.

Sending a top back costs nothing for 30 days, whether you post it or take it to a store. It also shares one online bag with Gap, so you can mix a $12.99 tank with Gap's organic cotton tees in a single order.
bodies.uniqlo:
Uniqlo is our pick for plain basics you choose by fabric rather than by trend. Its women's range covers simple pieces like the Crew Neck T-Shirt and the Soft Ribbed T-Shirt, and it's owned by Fast Retailing, the same group as GU.

Supima cotton and AIRism are each sold as their own line, and its men's tees in those lines run from $9.90 to $34.90. The women's sizes end at XL, a shorter run than Old Navy or Boohoo offer.

It has 86 US stores, which makes trying things on easy. Online orders ship free over $99 or to a store for pickup. Returns take 30 days, and the postage is on you unless Uniqlo sent the wrong thing.
bodies.yes-friends:
Yes Friends is the one to pick if you want cheap tees with organic cotton and good wages behind them. It's a UK label, and the Unisex Original T-shirt (£12, about $16) is where to start.

It says paying for good wages and organic cotton adds just 65p to each tee. Prices are in pounds, but a US order costs $9.95 to deliver, duties included, so the checkout total is the real total. That flat fee makes a single tee a poor buy. Bundle a few, like the Classic Heavyweight T-shirt (£16), to spread it.

Tees are the biggest part of its range, so pair it with Old Navy for the rest of your wardrobe.
bodies.gap:
Gap is Old Navy's pricier sibling, worth it when you want organic cotton basics from a store you can walk into. The Organic Cotton VintageSoft T-Shirt ($29.95) is the tee to get first.

The Modern Crop Cami ($19.95) is the cheapest full-price top, and the corduroy and vegan suede shirts top out at $89.95. So this is a different budget from Target's $8 tees. Orders ship free from $50.

Gap and Old Navy share a shopping bag online, but returns only go back to the brand you bought from. A Gap top can't be returned at Old Navy, so keep the receipts apart. With stores in 46 states, it's easy to try a size first.
bodies.armedangels:
Armedangels suits you if certified organic cotton and fair-trade production are worth paying more for. It's a German label from Cologne, and the LUALAA T-Shirt ($38) is its cheapest top.

It says its whole range is made that way, and it carries a Fair Wear Leader badge. The US store prices in dollars, with the IDAARA T-Shirt at $48. Shipping is a flat $15, so a single tee lands at $53. Buy two or three at once.

It calls its fit relaxed and European, so check the size guide on each piece. Returns take 30 days, sent back at your own cost. Yes Friends gets you organic cotton tees for less than half the price.
bodies.boohoo:
Boohoo is the online pick for trend-led tops across a wide size run, with US sizes 0 to 26, plus petite and tall cuts. It's a Manchester label that sells online, and its petite range is cut for a height of 5ft 3in.

The site runs offers like 70% off almost everything, and its own small print warns that a discount may not be measured against an earlier price. Look at the dollar figure at checkout instead.

A US delivery runs $10.99, and the site promises no extra tariff charges. Returns have a 21-day window, and each parcel costs $14.99 out of your refund, though taking store credit adds 20%. PrettyLittleThing, its sister label, works the same way on returns.
bodies.honest-basics:
Honest Basics is the cheapest way into organic basics on this list, with the Spaghetti Strap Top at €12.90 (about $14). It's a Berlin label selling basics for what it calls friendly prices.

The Basic T-shirt (€14.90, about $17) is its everyday tee. It works in organic and recycled cotton, and prices are in euros, so add the conversion before you compare.

Shipping is the catch. US orders pay €15 for up to 1 kg and arrive in three to six weeks, and duties may be added on arrival. That makes it a once-a-season order. Yes Friends includes duties in its $9.95 US delivery, so it's the easier buy if you only want one or two tees.
bodies.nordstrom-rack:
Nordstrom Rack is where name-brand tops drop to Old Navy prices. Most full-price tops sit between $19.97 and $39.97. The 1901 Crewneck Cotton T-Shirt ($14.97) and Madewell's Softfade Long Sleeve T-Shirt ($22.97) are good places to start.

Next to every price sits a comparable value figure. Treat it as a reference and judge the price itself, since the range runs all the way to designer pieces near $160.

Returns take 40 days, longer than most picks here, and you can drop online orders at a Rack store. Mailing them back takes $9.95 off the refund. Free shipping starts at $89, so it suits a bigger order better than one tee.
bodies.jcpenney:
JCPenney is the department-store route, with more than 600 US stores and a mix of national and private brands. James Cash Penney started it in Kemmerer, Wyoming, in 1902. It's also the reason Primark isn't called Penneys outside Ireland. The two clashed over the name in the 1970s.

Its Marilyn Monroe collection is exclusive to JCPenney, in stores and on its site, with an Off-the-Shoulder Top ($44) among the pieces. That's pricier than Target's basics, so start with the everyday brands rather than the collection.

Liz Claiborne, one of the labels it carries, runs from petite to plus. And its store count is more than ten times Primark's 47, so one is far easier to reach.
bodies.prettylittlething:
PrettyLittleThing is the trend-led pick, built around what it calls IT-girl style. It's a Manchester label, started in 2012 by brothers Adam and Umar Kamani, and it's part of the same group as Boohoo.

Its US size guide runs from 00 to 24, with petite and maternity ranges alongside the main one. The tall range covers 0 to 14, which few picks here offer at all.

US shipping is $9.99 an order. Returns work like Boohoo's, with 21 days and $14.99 taken off the refund, but store credit pays 10% extra here, half of Boohoo's bonus. For cheaper trend tops with fewer fees, try Forever 21, which ships free from $50.

closing.heading: How to choose
closing.body:
Start with what you can walk into. Target and Old Navy cover cheap everyday tops in person, and Target's $8 house-label tees are the cheaper start. Gap and Uniqlo also have stores, and JCPenney has more than 600.

If the lowest price online is the whole point, Missguided and Forever 21 go furthest down, but both charge you to send things back. For brand names at off-price, Nordstrom Rack is the one, with 40 days to return.

If organic cotton matters more than the lowest price, Honest Basics and Yes Friends both start under $17, and Armedangels is the spend-more option. For trend pieces in a wide size run, Boohoo and PrettyLittleThing are the online pair.

faqs.a: Yes. Primark opened its first US store in Boston in 2015, and its first Georgia store in September 2026 took it to 47 US stores.

faqs.q: What is the USA version of Primark?
faqs.a: Target comes closest on price, with house-label tops from $8 at regular price. Old Navy is the other everyday chain you can walk into, with tops from $12.99.
Associated British Foods owns Primark. In April 2026 it announced plans to spin Primark off as a separate company, with the split due by late 2027.
Primark is from Dublin, Ireland, where it opened in 1969 as Penneys. It still trades as Penneys in Ireland and uses the Primark name everywhere else.
